hooks.name: Review Documentation Evidence
hooks.description: 檢查儲存的產品文件是否清楚區分 Demo、正式產品與證據邊界，並避免未驗證宣稱或機密內容。

action.prompt: Review the saved documentation file only. Check that Demo capability, production design, and evidence boundaries are clearly labeled; factual claims and third-party content have appropriate sources or are marked as requiring validation; the content does not conflict with docs/specs/15-agreed-product-and-platform-direction.md, docs/specs/16-proactive-life-butler-and-commercial-loop.md, or docs/specs/17-conversational-agent-session-and-llm-wiki.md; and no secrets, credentials, tokens, private keys, or sensitive values are included. Report concrete issues and suggested documentation-only corrections. Do not modify application code.
